privacy.heading: Who handles your information
paragraphs: Hampstead Property Services Group Limited, company number 17404557, operates hpsg.co.uk, including Other services. Our address is Unit 3 Palace Court, 250 Finchley Road, London NW3 6DN. Contact office@hpsg.co.uk or 020 7101 3168 about your information.

privacy.heading: Enquiries and contact details
paragraphs: The enquiry form prepares a message in your own email application. Completing the form does not send it to us: you must review and send the email. We receive the name, contact details, property or area information, service selection and message you choose to send. Please do not send passwords, access codes, payment-card details or unrelated personal documents.

If you choose WhatsApp, you leave this website and use WhatsApp's service. We receive the contact and message information you share in that conversation. You can contact us by telephone or email instead.

privacy.heading: How we use information
paragraphs: We use enquiry information to understand your request, respond and discuss a possible appointment. Taking steps at your request before a contract, and carrying out an agreed contract, are the bases for that work. Our legitimate interests include handling general questions, keeping relevant correspondence and protecting the website against misuse. Records needed to meet legal obligations are handled for that purpose.

The website form does not add you to a marketing list. We do not sell personal information. If another business needs to take responsibility for your requested service, we explain the proposed introduction before sharing your enquiry with it.

privacy.heading: Providers and website data
paragraphs: Website hosting and delivery providers process technical information such as IP addresses, browser information and request logs to deliver and protect the site. Our business email is provided through Google Workspace. The current enquiry form does not send submissions through Resend or a separate form-processing API.

WhatsApp processes use of its own service under its privacy policy. Our hosting and communication providers may process information outside the UK under their applicable data-protection arrangements. We may also share relevant records with professional advisers, insurers or public authorities where necessary for the matter or required by law.
The Other services pages do not add advertising trackers, analytics cookies or chat storage. Links to maps and external services take you to providers with their own notices.

privacy.heading: How long information is needed
paragraphs: The relevant criteria are whether an enquiry is still active, whether it led to an instruction, whether correspondence is needed to explain an agreed scope, and whether a legal, accounting, insurance or dispute-related obligation requires a record. Information should not be retained once none of those purposes applies. Contact us to ask about the records held for your enquiry or to request deletion; a record may need to be retained where an ongoing obligation applies.

privacy.heading: Your choices and rights
paragraphs: You can ask to access or correct your information and, where applicable, request erasure, restriction or portability, or object to processing based on legitimate interests. Contact office@hpsg.co.uk. We may need to verify that a request relates to your own information.
You may complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/. You do not need to make an enquiry or supply personal information to browse the service pages.

terms.heading: The website operator
paragraphs: This website is operated by Hampstead Property Services Group Limited, company number 17404557, registered in England and Wales. Our address is Unit 3 Palace Court, 250 Finchley Road, London NW3 6DN. Contact office@hpsg.co.uk or 020 7101 3168.

terms.heading: Main services and Other services
paragraphs: hpsg.co.uk is our main website. Kitchens, bathrooms, painting and light refurbishment remain the main service pages. Other services brings together the wider service catalogue and information that helps you make a relevant enquiry.

A service listing is an invitation to discuss a requirement. It does not confirm availability, an appointment, professional status, a particular supplier or that a project is suitable without assessment. The business responsible for the work, the scope and any specialist appointments must be identified in the written proposal before you instruct work.

terms.heading: Enquiries, prices and appointments
paragraphs: Sending an enquiry does not place an order or accept a quotation. The enquiry form opens your email application; you must send the message yourself. We do not publish standard prices or promise a response or attendance time on the Other services pages.

A proposal for your particular work should state the scope, price, programme, payment arrangements and any applicable terms. Any warranty or guarantee needs to be expressly stated in that agreement; this website does not offer a blanket workmanship guarantee.

terms.heading: Information and images
paragraphs: General service information does not replace an assessment of your property, technical design or advice on a particular application or dispute. Do not rely on a service description as permission to carry out work.

Where the main website uses illustrative room photographs, these are described as illustrations rather than evidence of named completed projects. The Other services catalogue does not publish customer testimonials, ratings or project case studies.

terms.heading: External services and privacy
paragraphs: External links, including WhatsApp, are operated by their respective providers. Read their terms and privacy notices when you use them. Our privacy notice explains the enquiry information handled by HPSG.

terms.heading: Your rights and questions
paragraphs: These website terms do not remove any rights you have under applicable consumer law. Specific work is governed by the written agreement for that work. Contact office@hpsg.co.uk if any website information is unclear or to raise a concern.
